in_sanskrit.name: गनपत्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: गणनापति (Gana-Napati) - गण (Gana) means group, multitude, or collective; नपति (Napati) means lord or master. So, Ganapat is the lord or master of the group or collective.

in_hindi.name: गनपत
in_hindi.long_meaning: गणपत (Ganapat) - गण (Gana) का पति (Pat) है। गण के साथ रहने वाला प्रभावशाली पुरुष का नाम है। गण के साथ रहने वाला गणनापति (Ganapati) है।

in_tamil.name: கணபத்
in_tamil.long_meaning: கணபத் (Kanapadh) - கண் (Kan) means knowledge and பத் (Padh) means to protect or to have control over. So, Kanapadh is the one who protects or has control over knowledge.

in_telugu.name: గనపత్
in_telugu.long_meaning: గనపత్ (Ganapatam) - గణ (Gana) యొజనపై యొజనమై దేశియోజనము ప్రభావోదేశయోజనము, యొజనపై యొజనమై దేశీయోజనము. గణ యొజనపై యొజనమై దేశియోజనము పోజ్జేయోజనేయోజనే గనపతమ్. గణపతి (Ganapati) యే���� SC గొదోయేదు.

in_marathi.name: Ganapat
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Obstacles
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ganapat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lord of the Sacred Word, Remover of Obstacles, and the Wisdom Giver

in_bengali.name: Ganapat
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of Obstacles
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ganapat একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Lord of the Sacred Word, Remover of Obstacles, and the Wisdom Giver
